origin.description: Encode characters that are not left as-is in a URL.

arguments.name: reserved
arguments.text: When true, also encode reserved punctuation.

arguments.name: repeated
arguments.text: When true, encode percent signs that are already there.

origin.details: A string that already contains a percent-encoded byte is returned unchanged unless repeated is true. Space is always encoded. With reserved true, the reserved punctuation is encoded too.
origin.example:
bp_URLencode <- getFromNamespace("URLencode", "backports")
z <- "ab%20cd"
print(c(bp_URLencode(z), bp_URLencode(z, repeated = TRUE)))
print(bp_URLencode("a b"))
